description: Single source of truth for the RISE CS foresight graph. Editor dropdowns, Cytoscape styles, validation and views should all read from this file. See PLAN.md sections 2 and 5.

topic.label: Topic
topic.note: Foresight node. Use the 'kind' field to distinguish destination / stepping stone / enabler.

stone.label: Stepping stone
stone.note: The core node: a capability milestone with a horizon and readiness. Default kind.

destination.label: Destination (north star)
destination.note: A goal the department orients toward. Few of these. Rendered as an anchored block on the right of the roadmap view.

enabler.label: Enabler / trend / driver
enabler.note: External force that motivates a destination or gates a stone (trend, driver, regulation).

journey.label: Journey / depends-on
journey.note: Sequences stepping stones toward a destination — the roadmap backbone.

advances.label: Advances
advances.note: project -> stone, or stone -> destination. NEW in v1.

evidences.label: Evidences
evidences.note: publication -> stone. OUR progress: proof a stone is being reached. NEW in v1.

priorArt.label: Prior art
priorArt.note: publication -> stone. The BASELINE: foundational work defining the area, usually authored outside RISE. Deliberately distinct from `evidences` — reading the literature is not progress. Rendered weaker (dotted, thin) so baseline never looks like delivery.

horizon.label: Horizon
horizon.help: now = 0-2 yrs, next = 2-5 yrs, beyond = 5-10 yrs. Drives left-right position in the roadmap view.

owner.label: Owner
owner.help: Person/unit accountable for keeping this node current.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.help: Governs public visibility. Only 'public' nodes appear in a curated public build. Applies to every node.

source.label: Source
source.help: URL / citation / 'orcid' / 'diva' / 'manual'. Nodes only — on edges this key is the source node id, so edges carry updatedBy/updatedAt only.

updatedBy.label: Updated by
updatedBy.help: User id (set from SSO once auth is in place).

goodSteppingStone: A capability milestone (not a product, not a task), phrased as an outcome, with a horizon, a stated confidence, and at least one link (advances a destination or journey-depends on another stone).
theme: Light 'chart paper' theme: node fills carry white labels (all >=4.5:1); edge colours are drawn on #F3F5F9. Journey-line colours on the Roadmap are assigned per journey in code.js, not here.
